G2037.name: Erastus
G2037.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2037.brief: Companion of Paul; served as city treasurer in Corinth.
G2037.short: Erastus was a companion of Paul who served as the city treasurer in Corinth.

G2069.name: Esli
G2069.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G2069.short: Esli was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in His genealogy.

G2060H.name: Hermes
G2060H.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2060H.brief: A Christian in Rome greeted by Paul.
G2060H.short: Hermes was a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

G2057.name: Hermas
G2057.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2057.brief: A Christian in Rome greeted by Paul.
G2057.short: Hermas was a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

G2061.name: Hermogenes
G2061.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2061.brief: A believer who deserted Paul in Asia.
G2061.short: Hermogenes was one of the believers in Asia who deserted Paul during his imprisonment.

G2060G.name: Hermes
G2060G.brief: Greek god, associated with Paul and Barnabas
G2060G.short: In <ref="Act.14.12">Act.14.12</ref>, the people of Lystra identified Paul as Hermes, the Greek god of messages and eloquence, because he was the chief speaker.
